Title: Data and Automation Systems Builder
Description: Location: 100% Remote (Global) Timezone / Hours: Flexible working hours, with a requirement for partial overlap with US business hours (PT/ET) for synchronous team collaboration and meetings. Engagement Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor 🚀 The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software. We operate two core platforms: Customize Now (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network). We are a profitable, previously Silicon Valley-backed, fully remote company, and we are not just looking to improve manufacturing, we are looking for a visionary operator to help us truly revolutionize the global supply chain. 💻 The Role We're not looking for a traditional data analyst. We don't need someone to sit between our systems and the business interpreting what the numbers mean. We need a builder who can take a stated requirement ("we need this tracked," "alert us when this breaks") and ship it: a dashboard, an automated pipeline, or a real-time alert. A significant part of this role is exposing what’s already happening across our platforms: tracking when something enters a process, when it exits, and pinpointing where it gets stuck. This is closer to an automation and systems engineering role than classic business intelligence. You will work alongside our core engineering team and our Automation Engineer to connect, clean, and automate our entire data ecosystem. We would rather hire someone scrappy and technical who figures things out (researches, builds, breaks things, and fixes them) than someone with a polished analytics background who needs well-defined problems handed to them. The Big Vision You will own data across the entire organization. We are actively moving away from static dashboards and toward an AI-powered data engine where team members can type in natural-language queries, and the engine automatically fetches, processes, and analyzes the data in real time. Ultimately, you will build the central data heart of THE/STUDIO—a system where automated, data-driven decisions execute seamlessly across our operations. 🎯 What You’ll Do Architect the AI Data Engine: Build toward our long-term vision of an AI-driven, natural-language query interface and contribute to automating operational decision-making across the business. Build Automated Pipelines & Dashboards: Design self-sustaining systems (e.g., Looker/Looker Studio or equivalent BI tools) where metrics populate automatically with zero manual pulling. Ship End-to-End Solutions Independently: Take raw requirements from managers and build working systems without needing a formal spec or data translator. Deploy Real-Time Alerting: Build triggers that instantly flag process breakdowns or deviations, moving from retrospective reporting to proactive mitigation. Expose Process Timestamps: Surface stage-by-stage system events (entry/exit timestamps) across our core platforms to identify and fix operational bottlenecks. Engineer Workflow Automations: Build and maintain automated workflows (e.g., via n8n) linking our raw data sources directly to reporting and alerting tools. Solve Root-Cause Data Issues: Fix data quality and integrity issues directly at the source. Leverage AI as a Default: Use modern AI tools as a core build accelerant in your day-to-day workflow. Document for Enablement: Create clear, lightweight documentation so non-technical managers can use and navigate tools independently. Requirements A Builder & Engineer Mindset: You thrive when handed an ambiguous problem, navigating it through research, experimentation, and execution. Technical Foundation: Hands-on fluency with SQL and cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery or equivalent). Note: This is a foundational baseline, not the entire job. Tooling Proficiency: Deep experience with BI dashboarding (e.g., Looker Studio) and workflow automation platforms (e.g., n8n, Make, or custom scripts). End-to-End Ownership: Proven track record of building and deploying functional tools from scratch, not just querying existing databases. AI-First Workflows: Heavy daily reliance on AI tools to accelerate development, write code, and build system prototypes. Direct Stakeholder Communication: Comfortable talking directly to business leads to extract requirements without needing formal spec processes. 💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars) Our Founder/CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here: Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly. "Give a Shit" Energy (Extreme Ownership): You take 100% accountability for your domain and outcomes. You don't make excuses or blame external factors. You look inward, find solutions, and push across the finish line. Rapid Adaptation & Radical Candor: You embrace blunt, constructive feedback and pivot instantly without ego. You excel in a fast-moving environment where you need to act with urgency without waiting for hand-holding. 💰 Compensation & Terms Flexible & Competitive: We offer competitive, outcome-driven compensation packages tailored to the candidate's level of impact. Engagement Type: Full-time, exclusive independent contractor role. 🔎 Our Hiring Process Submit Application: IMPORTANT! Please submit your resume/CV in English Initial Screen: Brief intro chat to evaluate mutual fit, communications, and expectations. Hiring Manager Interview: Deep dive into your hard skills, past track record, and problem-solving approach. Assessment / Case Study: (If applicable for the role) Practical demonstration of your capabilities. Final Executive Interview: Conversation with key team members. Reference Checks: Verification of past performance with former leaders and CEOs. Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide feedback to all applications. THE/STUDIO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture free from discrimination.

Title: Associate Cloud FinOps Engineer
Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting, IT System Design Services, and IT System Custom Software Development
Description: Associate Cloud FinOps Engineer Location: Guadalajara, Mexico Hybrid, 3 days onsite and 2 days remote Compensation: MXM 41,700/Monthly with full benefits About the Role: We are looking for an Associate Cloud FinOps Engineer to join our Cloud Operations organization. This role will support cloud financial operations across the organization's cloud footprint and help provide visibility into cloud and third-party technology spending. The successful candidate will work closely with Cloud Operations, Finance, R&D, Engineering, and Procurement teams to track spending, support forecasting, prepare financial and operational reports, identify cost trends and anomalies, and contribute to cloud cost-optimization initiatives. This position is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines cloud knowledge, financial/data analysis skills, and strong Microsoft Excel expertise and wants to develop their career within Cloud FinOps. Key Responsibilities: Track, classify, analyze, and report cloud-related costs and other third-party application and system expenditures against approved budgets. Support financial visibility across the organization's cloud environment. Collaborate with Finance and R&D teams to support forecasting of variable and cloud-related expenditures. Prepare and maintain financial and operational reports for Cloud Operations, R&D, Finance, and other leadership stakeholders. Create and maintain automated and semi-automated Excel reports using multiple data sources. Build reports using advanced Excel capabilities including: Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Power Query, Advanced formulas, Data modeling Monitor cloud and third-party spending trends. Identify unusual spending patterns and potential cost anomalies. Proactively communicate financial risks, unexpected spending, or cost-saving opportunities to leadership. Work with Engineering teams to support cloud cost optimization initiatives. Track third-party spending associated with hosted applications and related systems. Support the creation and tracking of purchase orders. Help ensure cloud financial processes are documented, repeatable, auditable, and continuously improved. Work with multiple stakeholders across Cloud Operations, Finance, Engineering, Procurement, and R&D. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or an equivalent field. Minimum 1 year of experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel. Hands-on experience with: Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, Power Query, Data modeling, multi-source reporting Ability to analyze and work comfortably with large datasets. Strong attention to detail. Ability to work effectively across Finance, Engineering, Procurement, and Cloud Operations teams. Preferred Qualifications: Understanding of cloud billing and pricing models across AWS, Azure, or GCP. Exposure to FinOps or cloud financial management. Experience analyzing cloud consumption and cloud spending. Familiarity with cloud cost-management platforms such as: CloudZero, CloudHealth, Cloudability Experience with budgeting and forecasting. Experience detecting spending anomalies and identifying cost optimization opportunities. Experience preparing financial or operational reports for leadership. Exposure to purchase-order or third-party vendor-spend management. What We're Looking For: The ideal candidate is analytical, highly detail-oriented, comfortable working with financial and cloud data, and able to translate complex spending information into clear reporting for technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable working between technology and finance , rather than focusing solely on infrastructure engineering.
